subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: For Feishu outbound recovery after gateway restart, should the permanent fix be a Feishu WebSocket reconnect-triggered queue drain, a generic startup readiness gate, or an explicit restart retry-reset policy?
rationale: Current code already has a channel-owned reconnect-drain seam and sibling examples, but the reporter's workaround also proposes fixed sleep and retry reset, both of which change broader delivery semantics.

options.title: Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Wire Feishu WebSocket ready/reconnected lifecycle to drain matching pending Feishu deliveries through the existing shared queue-drain helper and prove it with live restart evidence.

options.title: Generic startup readiness gate
options.body: Delay generic startup recovery until channel readiness is visible, accepting a broader core policy change that needs cross-channel upgrade proof.

options.title: Retry reset policy
options.body: Define and test a restart-boundary retry reset or cap, accepting the risk that repeated genuine failures may be masked unless the rule is narrow.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Wire Feishu WebSocket ready/reconnected lifecycle to drain matching pending Feishu deliveries through the existing shared queue-drain helper and prove it with live restart evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining behavior is Feishu transport-specific and the package metadata identifies this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner signal.
